# keyfactor_permission_set (Data Source)

Reads an existing permission set from Keyfactor Command using the V1 `/PermissionSets` API. Compatible with Keyfactor Command versions 11+.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission set

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID of the permission set
- `permissions` (List of String) A list of permissions associated with the permission set
